answer_1.quote: We study open-ended text generation, in which a token sequence, x = {x1,…,xm}, is provided as context to a language model and the task is to generate a continuation, x = {x1,…,xc}, from the model's probability distribution, pθ(x).
answer_1.outputs: generated continuations of the provided contexts

answer_2.quote: We evaluate model collapse in terms of perplexity and accuracy. Diversity (D) takes into account the sequence-level repetition at different n‑gram levels. Self‑BLEU evaluates the BLEU score of each document compared to all other documents. MAUVE measures the distribution similarity between the original human text and the generated text. Readability is evaluated using the Flesch‑Kincaid Reading‑Ease score.
